description: Fix Edge Worker Turnstile verification to gracefully degrade when CF_TURNSTILE_SECRET is not configured, and update CORS headers to include x-turnstile-token in allowed headers.
steps: In apps/edge/src/index.ts, modify the Turnstile verification section (around line 62-73). When turnstileToken is present but env.CF_TURNSTILE_SECRET is not set/empty, log a warning and allow the request through instead of calling turnstileVerify (which would fail). Keep the existing behavior when the secret IS available.

In apps/edge/src/middleware/cors.ts, add 'x-turnstile-token' to the Access-Control-Allow-Headers list in getCorsHeaders(). Currently it only has 'Content-Type, Authorization, CF-Turnstile-Response'. Add 'x-turnstile-token' as the frontend sends this header.

Also in apps/edge/src/middleware/cors.ts, add support for Cloudflare Pages preview URLs (*.syrabitfrontend.pages.dev) in the ALLOWED_ORIGINS check. Modify the getCorsHeaders function to accept origins matching *.syrabitfrontend.pages.dev as valid, in addition to the hardcoded list.
Update apps/edge/tests/bot.test.ts to add a test case verifying that when CF_TURNSTILE_SECRET is empty/undefined, verification is skipped and the request passes through.
Update apps/edge/tests/cors.test.ts to add test cases for: (a) x-turnstile-token being in allowed headers, (b) Pages preview URL origin being accepted.
acceptance_criteria: When CF_TURNSTILE_SECRET is not set, auth/chat requests with a turnstile token are allowed through (not blocked with 403)
The CORS Access-Control-Allow-Headers includes both 'x-turnstile-token' and 'CF-Turnstile-Response'
Origins matching *.syrabitfrontend.pages.dev are accepted as valid CORS origins
All existing edge tests pass plus new tests for the above scenarios
findings: All 60 tests pass. TypeScript compiles without errors. The isAllowedOrigin helper function was extracted in cors.ts to avoid duplication between getCorsHeaders and applyCorsHeaders.
